nodes.label: .`an accepted weigh returns the weight and who it was attributed to`()
.`the request carries the session and the trimmed bag code as its only workflow field`()
.`a bag code the contract could never accept never reaches the broker`()
.`a refusal is translated through the contract's table`()
.`a refusal with no parsed body still yields the envelope's error code`()
.`an expired session is reported as a refusal that requires signing in again`()
.`no response is a failure the operator can retry, not a refusal`()
.`an accepted response for a different bag is never shown as this bag's weight`()
.`an accepted response from a different device is not trusted`()
.`an accepted response with no weight is malformed, not a zero-kilogram bag`()
.`an accepted weigh with no capturedBy still reports the weight`()
.`a thrown channel never escapes the use case`()
